input.quote: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, this Agreement may be terminated by either Party for cause as follows:
input.rationale: The Base Agreement runs for an initial three-year term (p0104) and Section 5.0 permits termination only for cause - material breach, insolvency, competitor acquisition, or continuing force majeure (p0107 to p0118). There is no convenience exit for IBM anywhere in the Agreement: Section 4.0's six-month notice is natural-term non-renewal (RENEWAL, not T4C) and SOW Section 6.1 lets IBM cancel individual Purchase Orders only, subject to cost reimbursement. Absence of any Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is a missing-behaviour deviation, so we insert the operative clause 'IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to MSL' with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Direction is checked: MSL has no mid-term convenience right, because Section 5.1 confines termination by either Party to cause, so preferred element 4 is already met and we add no new restriction on MSL. Placement inside Section 5.0 preserves Section 4.0's 'unless terminated as provided in Section 5.0' cross-reference, and Sections 5.2, 5.3 and SOW 6.1 are untouched. 60 to 90 days' notice is offered as the fallback concession.

proposal.summary: Add Section 5.4 giving IBM a 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.0 lets either Party exit only for cause, so across a three-year term we have no way to leave on notice. We have added a short Section 5.4 under which IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; if you prefer, we can move to 60-90 days' notice as our fallback.

ops.text: 5.4 Termination for Convenience by IBM. IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to MSL, in which case MSL shall refund to IBM, pro rata, any fees prepaid by IBM for the period after the effective date of termination.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
